name: Puerto del León Loop
description: Málaga's signature climb: the beautifully engineered A-7000 through the Montes de Málaga to Puerto del León and back. 46 km with one steady 15 km ascent starting minutes from the city.

name: Casabermeja, Riogordo and Colmenar Loop
description: The big Montes day: 88 km and nearly 2,000 m through Casabermeja, Riogordo and Colmenar, finishing over Puerto del León. The classic Málaga training loop.

name: Comares and Torre del Mar Loop
description: 97 km into the Axarquía: over Puerto del León, up to the balcony village of Comares and back along the coast from Torre del Mar.

name: Sierra de Mijas Loop
description: 61 km from Fuengirola around the Sierra de Mijas with the climb to the white village — the western Costa del Sol's standard ride.

name: Mijas Loop from Calahonda
description: 53 km with 1,200 m of climbing — the punchy Mijas circuit from the coast at Calahonda, ideal for repeat hill efforts.
